own_solution.law: Thevenin equivalent seen by the capacitor: R_th = R1 R2/(R1+R2), tau = R_th C; t_0.9 = tau ln 10

defect_reasons.insufficient_boundary_condition: The added capacitance in TDA93/TE837 is not stated to be uncharged; the authors' wiring (C -> C+q with zero initial voltage) relies on the natural reading that the capacitance is simply increased, which I accept.

notes: Verified: R_th = 2.7791 kOhm; base 22 uF: tau = 61.141 ms, t = 140.78 ms; 28.2 uF: 180.46 ms; 37 uF: 236.77 ms; 55 uF: 351.96 ms. Emf cancels from the fraction (C) correctly. Minimal pairs T1015/TDA93 and T6164/TE837 share 15 uF and differ in attachment/timing; numeral-free twins T7FFF/T1015 and TA387/T6164 match. Residual wording issues: the initial charge of the added capacitance is unstated, and TDA93's past tense 'had ... before the switch was closed' could be read as the extra capacitance being removed at closing. Both are wording-level; consistent with pass 1.
